subject: The Boy Who Stole Billions? (Prime Video docuseries)
query: when does the boy who stole billions come out
title: When does The Boy Who Stole Billions come out? Nov. 30 on Prime
answer: "The Boy Who Stole Billions?", a three-part documentary series about FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried, premieres on Prime Video on Sunday, Nov. 30, 2026, with all three episodes released at once. It features interviews Bankman-Fried gave from prison and is directed by Nanette Burstein.
body:
The series tells the rise and fall of FTX, the crypto exchange that was valued at $32 billion before it collapsed in November 2022. Director Nanette Burstein, who also executive produces, said she spent nearly three years interviewing Bankman-Fried, and Prime Video bills the series as his first on-camera interviews from prison. It also includes interviews with people who helped build FTX and looks at his inner circle, including his relationship with Caroline Ellison, the former head of the sister trading firm Alameda Research. The question mark in the title is deliberate: the series asks whether FTX was outright fraud or risky bets that spiraled out of control.

It is a documentary, so everything in it is real, but the verdict on the central question is already in. A Manhattan jury convicted Bankman-Fried on all seven counts, including wire fraud and conspiracy, in November 2023 over roughly $8 billion in missing customer money. He was sentenced to 25 years in March 2024, and a federal appeals court upheld the conviction in June 2026. He remains in federal prison; our explainer on whether he is still in prison covers his appeal and pardon request: https://trendrundown.com/x/is-sam-bankman-fried-still-in-prison

The series comes from Propagate and Amazon MGM Studios and streams in more than 240 countries and territories. The official trailer came out in early November and frames the story around the $8 billion in customer losses. The main draw is his own account of what went wrong, told years after a jury rejected it.
in_the_news: Prime Video releases all three episodes of "The Boy Who Stole Billions?" on Nov. 30, 2026.
